userStories.title: Visual Cohesion
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a consistent visual experience across all sections so that the portfolio feels like a unified brand.

userStories.title: Aesthetic Alignment
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to refactor mismatched components to align with the primary shader-driven and dithering aesthetic.

userStories.title: Layout Uniformity
userStories.description: As a user, I want transitions and layout spacing to be uniform across the Hero, About, and Contact modules.

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: About, Contact, and Projects sections updated to use the primary dithering/shader visual language
Global CSS variables for colors and typography strictly applied to all functional components
Layout padding and section transitions standardized across the entire scrollable viewport

mvp.reason: Aligns secondary sections with the Hero aesthetic

edgeCases.description: Multiple active dithering shaders on large background surfaces cause significant frame rate drops or browser crashes on low-end mobile devices.
Standardized layout padding on ultra-narrow viewports (under 320px) results in content clipping or unreadable text overlapping section boundaries.
Conflicting CSS transition logic between the smooth scrolling library and global layout variables causes jittery viewport positioning during section snaps.

testScenarios.description: Verify shader performance on low-spec hardware
testScenarios.when: scrolling through all shader-heavy sections rapidly
testScenarios.then: the UI remains responsive with no visible stuttering or GPU-related browser hangs

testScenarios.description: Validate visual accessibility with dithering effects
testScenarios.given: dithering shaders applied to sections containing small-font text
testScenarios.when: viewed on high-DPI versus low-DPI displays
testScenarios.then: text contrast and legibility meet WCAG AA standards without distracting moiré patterns

testScenarios.description: Confirm layout stability during viewport resizing
testScenarios.given: a browser window being resized from desktop to mobile
testScenarios.when: the global CSS variables for padding and transitions are active
testScenarios.then: sections re-align instantly without content overlapping or breaking the vertical scroll flow
